assessments.reasoning: The survey instrument uses the category 'jefa o jefe del hogar' (Question 5) to anchor the household record, rather than a neutral reference term such as 'reference person' or 'householder', so neutral_anchor_term is false. Neither the questionnaire nor the supplied methodological notes state an explicit rule for selecting the head of household, so explicit_selection_rule is false. Because no criterion for choosing the reference person is stated, rule_not_sex_age_authority is false. Question 2a specifies that information can be provided by an 'informante calificado' (qualified informant) when household members are absent, establishing that any knowledgeable adult may answer, so respondent_separate_or_any_adult is true.
